name: EditorApplication only sets up the application; behaviour lives in services and components
body:
# Components own their state, not EditorApplication

Dean (2026-11-05): with Chaos component children and `@provide`/`@context` merged (chaos-ui-framework #3), update the world editor so behaviour lives with its components and `EditorApplication` doesn't grow a method for each one. `EditorApplication.nyx` holds about 30 signals and 66 methods, many used by one component only.

Dean (2026-11-05, follow-up): EditorApplication is for setting up the application layer; any component logic in it gives it more than one responsibility. Move all of it into meaningful abstractions, adding Chaos mechanisms where needed.
plan:
EditorApplication keeps the application layer only: window title and size, font and DPI, mounting App.chaos, TickChaos, and saving preferences on shutdown.

Services, provided by App.chaos with `@provide` and read with `@context`, their state in `@signal` fields:

- `EditorDocument`: polls the revision from App's `OnTick` and holds the snapshots (outline revision, toolbar, status, history, log, recent files, inspector groups and their refill), and keeps the window title in sync.
- `EditorCommands`: RunCommand and the prefixed commands, the save-first confirm flow, and the open and save file dialogs.
- `EditorOverlays`: open menu, context menu, palette, help, settings, confirm, and what Escape closes.
- `EditorKeyboard`: shortcuts, modifier state, forwarding keys to the viewport.
- `EditorSelection`: click-to-select with modifiers and the hovered entity the context menu uses.

Panel state stays with the panel, or in a small state object it provides to its rows: OutlinerState, ConsoleFilters (provided by BottomPanel so it survives tab switches), Inspector's collapsed groups and new-property name, the asset preview, the palette query, the settings tab.

Chaos follow-up: a required `@context` with no initialiser, reporting an error when nothing provides it (chaos board card).
acceptance_criteria: Every panel, dialog, menu and shortcut behaves as before.
EditorApplication holds no component state or behaviour, only application setup.
definition_of_done: Screenshots of the panels in the chat
